5059442204663.sourceDescription:
Nordmann Fir is a hugely popular Christmas tree due to its rich green foliage, soft needles, and naturally well-balanced shape. The broad, sturdy branches provide plenty of room for decorations, while the foliage has excellent needle retention, helping the tree stay looking fresh throughout the Christmas period. The needles are also less prickly than many other conifers, making decorating easy and safe for little hands without the risk of being scratched.
A DISTINCTIVE NORDMANN FIR: The foliage has a rich green colour and a glossy appearance, while the needles are broad, soft, and blunt-tipped. This gives the Nordmann Fir its characteristic look and makes it a particularly popular variety for Christmas.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Product Overview

 Create magical festive wall decor with this DIY S‑shaped Christmas train wall art kit. The kit includes pre‑cut acrylic panels, warm‑white LED string lights, cotton cloud material and mounting accessories. 
 You need to assemble all parts by yourself, arrange the cotton clouds and stick acrylic pieces onto your wall with 3M adhesive. 
 Final visual effect depends on your personal installation, layout and wall background, results may vary. 

Specifications

 Total finished size: 60cm / 23.62 inch (after assembly)
 Kit contents:
 
 3 pieces printed acrylic decorative panels
 1 x warm‑white LED light string (powered by 2pcs 2032 button batteries, batteries included)
 Several pieces of cotton for cloud simulation
 Multiple 3M adhesive tapes for wall mounting
 
 
 Assembly: 100% DIY manual installation, all components are loose parts, not pre‑assembled
 Light color: Warm white LED glow
 Mounting: Apply 3M back glue to stick acrylic pieces and cotton onto smooth wall surfaces

Application Scenarios
Living room wall, entry hall, bedroom, stairway background wall, Christmas party backdrop, seasonal home display, holiday craft project.
Important Notes

 This is a DIY kit, NOT finished wall art. All parts are loose, customers must complete cutting, arranging and pasting installation by themselves. The final visual effect is subject to user’s manual operation, effect varies from person
 to person.
 3M adhesive tapes are suitable for smooth, clean flat walls. Not recommended for rough, peeling or fragile painted walls.
 Cotton material is loose filling, arrange it manually to simulate cloud shape.

【Eye-Catching Night Focal Point】It Shines Brightly After Dark to Build a Dramatic Centerpiece. Instantly Create a Cozy, Magical Christmas Vibe to Impress Your Guests.
【Memorable Gift for Christmas Lovers】More than ordinary holiday decor, this illuminated wall accent creates a festive experience families can enjoy year after year. A fun christmas gift idea for parents, grandparents, families, collectors and anyone who loves decorating for the holidays

Product Description

 This crystal cascade Christmas hanging light is a festive vertical hanging decoration with LED lights. 
 It features 6 optional holiday‑themed styles including Santa, Snowman, Crystal Ball, Cardinal, Snowflake and Warm Crystal Ball. 
 Adorned with simulated crystal drops, snowflake LED ornaments, pine sprigs and berry accents, the cascading strand design creates brilliant sparkling lighting effect.

 Outdoor residential: Front porch, patio, doorway, eaves, gazebo for Christmas hanging decor

 Christmas gift choice for family and friends

Climbing Santa Decoration
This climbing santa decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

8941467526363.baseName: Christmas Bells for Decoration Set of 4 Vintage Gold Jingle Bells with Jute Hanging Rope Rustic Iron Ornaments
8941467526363.variantName: Christmas Bells for Decoration Set of 4 Vintage Gold Jingle Bells with Jute Hanging Rope Rustic Iron Ornaments
8941467526363.sourceDescription:
A set of four vintage style jingle bells in an antique gold finish, threaded onto jute twine that is already tied at the top, so they can be hung the moment they come out of the box. Each bell is handmade from recycled iron sheet with a deliberately rough, worn paint finish. Small variations in tone and surface are part of the design rather than a fault, and no two bells match exactly: the finish is closer to old brass than bright gold, so they look as though they have hung in a barn for years.

The bells are made for Christmas decorating. Hang them on the tree, wire them into a wreath, or tie them to a door handle, fireplace mantel, staircase or chair back. Their soft chime also suits a simple bell garland, a wind chime for the porch, or wedding and table decoration, and the antique gold reads as festive without looking brassy. One bell on a kitchen cupboard handle works just as well as the whole set grouped together on a door.

The rustic country look fits farmhouse, shabby chic and traditional interiors and sits comfortably beside more contemporary schemes. Often sold as harmony bells, the same shape is used for Tibetan style meditation sets, where the chime alone is the point. As a gift, a set of bells is an easy choice for Christmas, Thanksgiving, a birthday or an anniversary, and the muted gold tone works all year round.

Supplied as four bells on jute hanging rope. Finish, colour and surface texture vary slightly from piece to piece.

8776446731663.sourceDescription:
1. Artificial Pine Needles and Red Berries: A Classic Christmas Palette
This Christmas wreath features artificial pine needles accented with red berries, showcasing a classic Christmas color scheme and rich, layered detail. Its lifelike design is perfect for festive decor, adding a touch of Christmas spirit to storefront
 windows, retail spaces, and home interiors.
2. Ideal for Storefronts, Retail Spaces, and Thematic Decor
Perfect for window displays, entryway accents, or general festive arrangements, this wreath can also be hung on front doors, walls, windows, or in entryways. It is well-suited for both commercial displays and home holiday decorating, helping to create
 a lively and cozy Christmas atmosphere.
3. Versatile Design for Flexible Styling
The artificial wreath complements a wide range of holiday decor styles. It can be further customized with elements like ribbons, string lights, or pinecones (depending on the specific product structure). It is an excellent choice for Christmas parties,
 retail displays, family gatherings, and winter holiday settings.
4. Easy-to-Hang Design
Designed for hanging, the wreath can be mounted using appropriate hooks, cords, or fasteners (depending on the product's specific construction). When used outdoors or near an entrance, it is recommended to place it in a sheltered area to protect it from
 direct rain and harsh weather conditions.
5. Perfect for Holiday Decor and Gifting
An ideal choice for home Christmas decor, retail window displays, or event settings; it also makes a thoughtful gift for those who love Christmas decorations. The dimensions are approximately 50x50 cm. Please verify the product size and your available
 hanging space before placing your order to ensure it fits your intended window, door, or wall area.

Bring festive cheer to your home with this 240cm Inflatable Santa Claus Christmas Decoration, perfect for creating a welcoming Christmas display in your garden, front lawn, driveway or festive entrance. Featuring a cheerful smiling face and friendly waving pose, this inflatable Father Christmas adds seasonal charm to any outdoor setting. Designed for quick and easy assembly, the built-in electric blower inflates Santa in approximately 1–2 minutes. Simply connect the blower cable securely to the supplied power adapter and plug into a suitable AC 220–240V outlet. For added stability, the decoration includes two 500ml water weight bags, which can be filled, securely capped and inserted into the base or feet through the bottom zipper. Ensure the zipper is fully closed before use. Five plastic ground stakes and 1.5m securing tethers are also included to help anchor Santa firmly in position. Attach the tethers to the side loops and insert the stakes into grass at approximately a 45° angle for additional support. Crafted from durable, tear-resistant 210T polyester, this outdoor inflatable Christmas decoration is lightweight, easy to clean and designed for repeated seasonal use. Once Christmas is over, simply disconnect the power, allow Santa to deflate, empty the water bags and ensure everything is thoroughly dry before folding away for compact storage. Ideal for Christmas garden displays, festive parties and seasonal home decorations, this waving inflatable Santa Claus is a delightful way to spread Christmas cheer.
240cm INFLATABLE SANTA CLAUS: Create a cheerful Christmas display with this 122cm tall inflatable Father Christmas featuring a friendly waving pose. Perfect for gardens, front lawns, driveways and festive entrances.
QUICK & EASY INFLATION: Built-in electric blower inflates Santa automatically in approximately 1–2 minutes. Simply connect the blower cable to the supplied power adapter and plug into a suitable AC 220–240V outlet.
2 × 500ML WATER WEIGHT BAGS: Includes two water bags for added stability. Fill with water, secure the caps tightly and insert into the base or feet through the bottom zipper, ensuring it is fully closed.
5 GROUND STAKES & 1.5M TETHERS: Secure your outdoor inflatable Santa using the five included plastic ground stakes and 1.5m tethers. Attach to the side loops and position stakes at a 45° angle in grass for a firm hold.
DURABLE 210T POLYESTER: Made from lightweight, tear-resistant polyester fabric for repeated seasonal use. Easy to maintain by wiping clean with a damp cloth.
REUSABLE & COMPACT STORAGE: Easily deflates after Christmas for convenient storage. Simply disconnect the power, empty the water bags and allow all components to dry thoroughly before packing away.
PERFECT FOR OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAYS: An eye-catching festive decoration ideal for Christmas gardens, front lawns, seasonal parties and welcoming guests throughout the festive season.
Guarantee - 1 year

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

5059442001163.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.

It is time to enjoy decorating your own Christmas tree with the whole family at this time of the year!
Snow Dusted Look: Christmas is no fun without a glance of snow, this frosted artificial Christmas tree helps bring significant elements of this exciting holiday into your sweet home. The lush tips and sprayed white snow are all lifelike with natural appearances, ready to make your Christmas a festive and unforgettable memory.
Premium Quality Material: Jump into the holiday joy with this lush artificial tree. Flexible Tips: The “leaves” on our tree can be bent and set at will. After putting the tree body and the stand together, you are supposed to fluff out the tips to give a full look at your unique Christmas tree. All tips are bendable and can be set in a certain direction, normally the fluffing-out procedure includes two steps: lifting up the top tips and pulling out the side tips.
Practical: This artificial Christmas tree perfectly combines realism and budget, which is great for living rooms, dining rooms, apartments and other small spaces. You can place it beside the sofa, in front of a window, or in a corner of your room to create an eye-catching focal point.
